name: Ephedrine Sulfate
indications_original: Ephedrine sulfate injection is indicated for the treatment of clinically important hypotension occurring in the setting of anesthesia.
contraindications_original: Treatment of hypotension developing during anesthesia: Bolus intravenous injection: 5 to 10 mg as needed, not to exceed 50 mg.  Dilute before use.  See Full Prescribing Information for instructions on administration and preparation for injection. (2)
